name: Gilead
summary: The father of Jephthah, whose son was born to a harlot. His wife's sons later drove Jephthah out of their father's house.

key_moments.title: His Sons Drive Jephthah Out
key_moments.description: Gilead was the father of Jephthah, whose mother was a harlot. When the sons of Gilead's wife grew up, they drove Jephthah out, saying he would not inherit in their father's house, for he was the son of another woman.
